decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds directly on the firm's established postpress know-how and has kept its own page for two years, so the firm can interpret its results and integrate it into its modular automated workflows.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer and has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, which the firm's application know-how and service technicians can build on, though it gets less website prominence than C.
